items.title: 10.16 Calculation of standard potential (E cell) (standard cell potential ka hisab) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.16 with Figure 10.8 and Quick Check 10.7, printed pages 230-231.

blocks.text: E° values se do half-cells se bane electrochemical cell ka voltage nikala ja sakta hai, chahe un mein se koi bhi standard hydrogen electrode na ho. Napa gaya voltage dono half-cells ki E° values ka farq (difference) hai. Is value ko standard cell potential (E°cell) kehte hain.
Figure 10.8 (a) ke electrochemical cell ki do half-equations yeh hain:
Yani is cell ka voltage +1.56 V hai, jaisa Figure 10.8 (b) mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Do half-cells 298 K par salt bridge se jure: Ag+ (1 mol/dm3) mein silver rod (Ag), terminal +, aur Zn2+ (1 mol/dm3) mein zinc rod (Zn), terminal -, voltmeter 1.56 V; taar par teer zinc se silver ki taraf, dono ends par e-. (b) +1.00 se -1.00 tak E standard ka scale (paimana): Ag+ + e- aur Ag ka equilibrium +0.80 V par (red), Zn2+ + 2e- aur Zn ka equilibrium -0.76 V par (blue), darmiyan 1.56 V ka double arrow.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.8: (a) Ag+/Ag, Zn2+/Zn electrochemical cell, (b) +0.80 V aur -0.76 V ka farq +1.56 V hai (kitab ki Figure 10.8 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hissa (b) mein dono half-equations E° ke scale par apni jagah rakhi gayi hain; un ke darmiyan ka faasla hi cell ka voltage hai: +0.80 − (−0.76) = +1.56 V. Hissa (a) mein electrons negative zinc se positive silver ki taraf behte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 10.8 (a) mein taar par e⁻ ke teer silver (+) se zinc (−) ki taraf bane hain; electrons zinc se silver ki taraf jate hain, is liye upar ke diagram mein teer sahi direction mein hain. Hissa (b) mein dono half-equations apni sahi jagah (+0.80 V aur −0.76 V) par rakhi gayi hain.

blocks.title: Standard cell potential
blocks.text: E°cell = zyada positive half-cell (jahan reduction hoti hai) ka E° − zyada negative half-cell (jahan oxidation hoti hai) ka E°.

blocks.prompt: i) Voltaic cell mein salt bridge ka kya kaam hai?
blocks.explanation: Salt bridge dono half-cells ke darmiyan ions ko chalne de kar circuit poora karta hai aur dono solutions ko neutral (ionic balance) rakhta hai; is se electrons ka flow jari rehta hai. Salt bridge na ho to charge jama ho jata hai, current ruk jata hai aur voltage zero ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: ii) Iron aur copper electrodes wale cell ka voltage nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Fe²⁺/Fe ka E° = −0.44 V aur Cu²⁺/Cu ka E° = +0.34 V. Iron zyada negative hai, is liye anode: E°cell = (+0.34) − (−0.44) = +0.78 V.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Quick Check 10.7 (ii) mein Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ Cu(s) ka E° bhi −0.44 V chhapa hai, jo iron ki value dobara likh di gayi hai. Copper ka sahi E° +0.34 V hai (Figure 10.9 aur Table 10.2 bhi yehi dete hain), is liye cell ka voltage +0.78 V hai.
Ag⁺/Ag half-cell ki E° value Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell se zyada positive hai. Is liye Ag⁺/Ag half-cell, cell ka positive pole aur Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell negative pole hai.

blocks.prompt: Ni²⁺/Ni (−0.25 V) aur Co²⁺/Co (−0.28 V) ke cell mein anode kaun sa hai aur E°cell kitna hai?
blocks.explanation: Cobalt ka E° zyada negative hai, is liye cobalt oxidize hota hai: cobalt anode, nickel cathode. Overall: Co + Ni²⁺ → Co²⁺ + Ni; E°cell = (−0.25) − (−0.28) = +0.03 V.

items: E°cell = do half-cells ki E° values ka farq: E°(zyada positive) − E°(zyada negative).
Ag/Zn cell: +0.80 − (−0.76) = +1.56 V; Ag⁺/Ag positive pole, Zn²⁺/Zn negative pole.
